_doc: One row per Harmony hook into Space Engineers. type/method are verified against the installed game DLLs by tools/preflight.ps1. feature must resolve in features.json.

rows.purpose: If the render device is recreated while VR is on, keep the per-eye backbuffer size
Log the backbuffer size the engine actually applied
Remember the game camera, then overwrite the main environment matrices with the current eye's OpenXR pose and asymmetric FOV
Prefix: xrWaitFrame/BeginFrame/LocateViews/SyncActions, left eye pass. Postfix: copy left eye, draw the frame again for the right eye, copy it
Replay the recorded HUD/GUI command list in the right eye pass so the HUD is in both eyes
Release the swapchain image and xrEndFrame (projection layer, or a floating quad while a menu is open)
Report every gamepad axis as present while VR is active
Keep the virtual gamepad connected even though DirectInput finds no device
Replace the joystick state with the virtual gamepad built from VR controllers
